$comment: Reference fetcher (P2-T3, D11): yt-dlp and the Deno it runs YouTube's challenge solver on (EJS). Both on demand (tiers []): the first pasted link installs them, deno first. Hosted at components.taalcut.app by tools/components/hosting (README.md, "Releasing components"; hosting/plan.mjs pins each source). yt-dlp 2026.10.21 (the newest stable tag, commit 6ccd977303412151ee23352c6257dd658ffc1987) is built by Taalcut from its tagged source by tools/components/yt-dlp/pack.mjs, the way upstream builds its macOS release: a PyInstaller onedir (yt-dlp beside its _internal/ folder, nothing unpacked at run time) with lazy extractors and upstream's hash-locked requirements (curl_cffi included), on python-build-standalone's relocatable CPython 3.14.9, arm64 only. Every Mach-O is signed with Taalcut's Developer ID (hardened runtime, secure timestamp, no entitlements) and notarised by Apple, and the build is run (--version, an extraction from a local page, the same under the fetcher's sandbox profile) before it is packed as tar.zst with LICENSES/ (every bundled piece and its licence, INVENTORY.txt). The file as a whole is GPL-3.0-or-later; the sources of its copyleft pieces (mutagen, the PyInstaller bootloader, certifi), yt-dlp's own and Taalcut's build scripts are hosted beside it under source/, as its NOTICE.txt says. Deno is 2.9.6 from npm's @deno/darwin-arm64, hosted unchanged (a tar.gz, which the manager extracts; npm sha512 integrity verified; the deno binary is Developer ID-signed and notarised by Deno Land Inc., 2H4KBF436B, hardened runtime, and keeps that signature), with the seven MPL-2.0 crates it is built with hosted beside it under source/crates/. Stable yt-dlp goes stale within weeks: a newer tag is a new version through the same release path (tools/components/README.md, "The reference fetcher"). sign-manifest.mjs drops this comment.

yt-dlp 2026.10.21 (Unlicense source), built by Taalcut with PyInstaller; the build bundles GPL code (mutagen, the PyInstaller bootloader), so this file is GPL-3.0-or-later. Every bundled piece, its licence and where the sources are is in its NOTICE.txt.
